raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Optimizes XPU FP8 linear by pre-materializing scale layouts during weight loading and enabling fused rowwise `scaled_mm` for channelwise FP8 weights when the input shape and scale layouts are supported.

FP8 linear layers using Torch scaled_mm may perform redundant scale-layout conversions during every forward pass. For block-wise FP8, the required transpose-contiguous layout can be materialized once after weight loading. For channelwise FP8, XPU supports fused rowwise scaled_mm, but the path requires per-token activation scaling and a [N, 1] weight-scale layout.

## Modifications

- Materialize scale layout during weight loading.
- Enable `use_per_token_if_dynamic` and fused rowwise scaled_mm.

## Accuracy Tests

test_xpu_fp8_linear.py

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N=K=1024:
Block-scale layout materialization reduced block FP8 scaled_mm latency by approximately 8.7% to 10.0% across M=1, 8, 128.
Fused rowwise scaled_mm reduced latency by approximately:
  26.9% at M=8
  26.7% at M=128


## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

+            torch.tensor(0.05, device=self.device), requires_grad=False
+        )
+        method.process_weights_after_loading(layer)
+        self.assertEqual(layer.input_scale.shape, torch.Size([]))
+
+        x = torch.randn(4, K, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=self.device) / 3
+        output = method.apply(layer, x)
+
+        q_input = (
+            (x.float() / layer.input_scale.float())
+            .clamp(-448, 448)
+            .to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+        )
+        # layer.weight is stored transposed as (K, N) after loading.
+        reference = (q_input.float() * layer.input_scale.float()) @ (
+            layer.weight.float() * layer.weight_scale.float().t()
+        )
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            output, reference.to(torch.bfloat16), rtol=0.05, atol=0.2
+        )
+
+    def test_prequantized_vector_scale_with_channelwise_weight_scale(self):
+        """A one-element pre-quantized input scale is treated as scalar."""
+        M, K, N = 4, 256, 384
+        q_input = torch.randn(M, K, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=self.device).to(
+            torch.float8_e4m3fn
+        )
+        weight = torch.randn(K, N, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=self.device).to(
+            torch.float8_e4m3fn
+        )
+        weight_scale = torch.full((N, 1), 0.5, device=self.device)
+        input_scale = torch.tensor([0.25], device=self.device)
+
+        output = apply_fp8_linear(
+            input=q_input,
+            weight=weight,
+            weight_scale=weight_scale,
+            input_scale=input_scale,
+            use_per_token_if_dynamic=True,
+            compressed_tensor_quant=True,
+            pre_quant_output_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        )
+        reference = (q_input.float() * input_scale.float()) @ (
+            weight.float() * weight_scale.t()
+        )
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            output, reference.to(torch.bfloat16), rtol=0.01, atol=0.1
+        )
+
 
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
